reviewedBy: benchmark lane (issue #7), human review of the category list and its detection rule
note: Each category records what the harness must observe before it reports the category. A category is only reported from evidence, never from the operator's summary of the run.

categories.label: A required artifact test failed after the work landed
categories.evidence: the gate ledger for the task records a failed command gate
categories.detection: any required command gate with status failed and no earlier category

categories.label: An integration merged but dropped one side's intent
categories.evidence: the merge commit exists, the task's behavior gate fails
categories.detection: integration-conflict task with a failed behavior gate

categories.label: A later stack layer broke an earlier layer
categories.evidence: the failing gate belongs to a layer whose earlier layer had passed
categories.detection: stacked-pull-request task with a failed layer gate

categories.label: Recovery repeated a durable side effect
categories.evidence: the durable effect log holds a repeated effect id after recovery
categories.detection: crash-recovery duplicate count greater than zero

categories.label: Review missed the planted defect or invented one
categories.evidence: the recorded findings do not name the planted location, or they name the clean control

categories.label: Long context work acted on the wrong slice
categories.evidence: the failing invariant names a module outside the repaired set
categories.detection: long-context-program task with a failed invariant gate

categories.label: A public interface changed while fixing internals
categories.evidence: the recorded surface file and the module exports differ
categories.detection: interface-api-regression task with a failed surface gate

categories.label: The work touched a path outside the brief scope
categories.evidence: the gate ledger records SCOPE_VIOLATION with the changed paths
categories.detection: any required gate blocked with reason SCOPE_VIOLATION

categories.label: The work changed the checks instead of the code
categories.evidence: a changed path matches checks/** or the gate coverage check fails
categories.detection: INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE or a scope violation naming checks/**

categories.label: A worker or its task report failed before verification
categories.evidence: the call error or the ledger reason records a failed call or an incomplete task report

categories.label: The run stopped at a declared budget
An artifact test could not run in this environment
categories.evidence: the gate ledger records COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED, ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE or CHECK_UNAVAILABLE
categories.detection: gate blocked with an environment reason

categories.label: A gate demanded human approval that was not recorded
The harness could not map the observation to a category
categories.evidence: the row records no matching rule, the raw state stays in the row
categories.detection: no other rule matched; treated as a harness defect and reported as unverified
